hit_rule.description: Hit = the bash tool was asked to run a `source .../activate` command (walked the path) AND the tool result returned to the model for that very call (next tool message in logs/network.jsonl) is the no-shell failure: `Failed to create terminal` (ACP terminal/create with argv[0]='source'/'cd' -> ENOENT) or `source: not found`.

all.value: command[\\"]*: ?[\\"]*(cd [^&]{1,80}&& )?(source|\.) \S*activate[^}]{0,200}\}[^{]{0,200}\{[\\"]*role[\\"]*: ?[\\"]*tool[\\"]*, ?[\\"]*content[\\"]*: ?[\\"]*<tool_error>bash failed: (Failed to create terminal|[^<]{0,300}source: not found)

runs.evidence: step 2: 'source .venv/bin/activate && which python', 'source .venv/bin/activate', '. .venv/bin/activate' -> each '<tool_error>bash failed: Failed to create terminal: RequestError('Internal error')' (no terminal_started event); model then wrapped in 'bash -c ...' which succeeded (/home/agent/workspace/.venv/bin/python). Step 1 also shows operators passed literally: 'ls: cannot access '&&': No such file or directory'.
step 2: 'source .venv/bin/activate && which python' x3, '. .venv/bin/activate && which python' -> 'Failed to create terminal: RequestError('Internal error')'; 'bash -c ...' succeeded.
step 2: 'cd /home/agent/workspace && source .venv/bin/activate && which python' -> 'Failed to create terminal' (argv[0]='cd', builtin, same no-shell mechanism); model fell back to writing a script.
step 2: 'source .venv/bin/activate && which python' x3, 'source .venv/bin/activate; which python' -> 'Failed to create terminal: RequestError('Internal error')'.

step 2: 'source /home/agent/workspace/.venv/bin/activate && which python' x2 -> 'Failed to create terminal'; "sh -c 'source ...'" -> 'sh: 1: source: not found' (dash, model's own sh); 'bash -c ...' succeeded.
step 2: 'source .venv/bin/activate && which python' x2 -> 'Failed to create terminal: RequestError('Internal error')'.
step 2: 'source .venv/bin/activate && which python' x3, 'source .venv/bin/activate', '. .venv/bin/activate' -> 'Failed to create terminal: RequestError('Internal error')'.
step 2: 'source /home/agent/workspace/.venv/bin/activate && which python' x2, 'source ...activate' -> 'Failed to create terminal'; final text: '`&&` is not interpreted as a shell operator'.
step 2: 'source .venv/bin/activate && which python' x3 -> 'Failed to create terminal'; 'bash -c ...' succeeded.
step 2: 'source .venv/bin/activate && which python' x3 -> 'Failed to create terminal: RequestError('Internal error')'.

steps: Create a Python virtual environment in the workspace: run `python3 -m venv .venv` with the bash tool, then confirm `.venv/bin/activate` exists.
Activate that virtual environment and print the active interpreter in a single shell command: `source .venv/bin/activate && which python`.
